This past weekend, I had the opportunity to compete in the Google DevFest WashU 2025 hackathon! 🚀 Out of 42 teams and 113 hackers from 6 different colleges and universities, my team was selected as one of just 10 finalists! 🎉 Given 24 hours, a Gemini API key, and the theme "AI in ___," we were challenged to build an innovative AI solution for an industry using Google Gemini. Two hours in, we landed on our idea: AI in Software Engineering. With the rise of engineers relying on AI-generated code (or what many now call "vibe coders"), it’s becoming harder to onboard new teammates, pick up where someone else left off, or even just understand existing code. I worked with Sochie Odunlami , Henry Anyimadu , and Koji Wong to build Unveil AI, a full-stack web app that helps engineers (or really anyone) make sense of code. By just uploading a GitHub repo or local directory, you can: • Get line-by-line explanations of your code • Ask clarifying questions about specific files or functions • Even receive a phone call from an AI “senior developer” (powered by Bland AI) who walks you through your codebase Huge shoutout to Isaiah N. Granet for providing us with free Bland AI API tokens, this feature wouldn’t have been possible without him. With mentors, keynote speakers, and judges from Google , Microsoft , McKinsey & Company , Wells Fargo , and the local community, this was a valuable learning opportunity. Thank you Google Developer Group WashU for organizing such a memorable event! 🙌 ...more ...more

🏆 Proud to have won 2nd place in my first hackathon! Last weekend, Koji Wong , Lotanna Okoli , Tarun Eswar , and I had the opportunity to compete in the Meta x 8VC Llama Stack Hackathon hosted by WashU Skandalaris Center for Interdisciplinary Innovation & Entrepreneurship and McKelvey Build Fellowship . We built Intern-X, a full-stack website that: - Searches the web for recruiters and alumni from your school in your career field - Uses the @ Hunter.io API to find their emails - Uses the Llama stack to generate high-quality, relevant cold emails - Has a seamless, easy-to-use user interface Thank you WashU Skandalaris Center for Interdisciplinary Innovation & Entrepreneurship , Meta , and 8VC for hosting this hackathon! Learn more about our project on our Github: https://lnkd.in/gnEaNmv5 . #Hackathon #Meta #AiAgents #8VC ...more ...more

Also represented Hopkins at the Amgen North America Symposium at Harvard University . Thank you to Dr. Thakor and Manan Bhatt , the Neuroengineering (NEBI) Lab, Amgen Foundation, Dr. Bohn , and Dr. Hilser for their support. ⠀

I met with over 20 startups this summer as a design intern, and here's one lesson that stuck with me. In just 10 weeks, I worked with more than 20 startups and shipped 8 projects. Every week meant switching contexts, learning new industries, and translating complex ideas into designs that founders could trust. My biggest takeaway wasn't about design tools. It was realizing that the best design starts long before the first wireframe. It starts with listening. Every founder had a different way of communicating, a different vision, and different priorities. Learning to ask better questions and understand the "why" behind each idea made every design decision stronger. Thank you to my managers, Kelly Nyikes and Samantha Page , for leading our team with constant support, encouragement, and mentorship throughout the entire 10 weeks (YAY!). Special thank you to my past manager, Yannic D. , and my year long past client, Sergiu Celebidachi , for investing/guiding in me through SDA before the internship even began and giving me the confidence to hit the ground running. And thank you to every founder and team I had the chance to work with at WashU Skandalaris Center for Interdisciplinary Innovation & Entrepreneurship , especially the Launchpad founders, SKIP founders, and the TrustedTap team. It was a privilege to help bring your ideas to life. Featured Projects/Pictured at Expo: Kayno Labs ( Jeffrey Christian C. ), Amass Biosystems ( Justin Traenkle ), ReferencePoint ( Eli Abdou ), Netty’s Juicery® ( Ginette Rhodes ), Blumiin ( Julius Chembo, Ph.D ), SPARC Sports , Brian Lee (SDA), Trusted Tap ( Nwaliweaku Anidi, MPH & Mia Salamone , and ChiChi ( Jillian Wu & Chiara Munzi ). Looking forward to taking everything I learned into my junior year and upcoming future product design internships.
